tha-ap529:1.1: Girinelapūjaka.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ vicine vicaraṃ ahaṃ / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ. // //
tha-ap529:2.1: Tasmiṃ mahākāruṇike sabbasattahite rate / pasannacitto sumano nelapupphaṃ apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap529:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap529:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Girinelapūjako thero i. g. a-ti.
